statement: For s>0,p=pi(A),b=1-p, r_s=s+E_pi|A sum_out q_xy P_y(Exp(s)<tau_A),R_s=1/(p*r_s)-1/s. The supplied theorem gives R_s/[b(1+s/g)]<=M<= (1+s/g)R_s/b without reversibility. The stronger reversible lower R_s/b is FALSE for directed cycles. Forward exit rates,not adjoint sampling,are used. Relative r_s precision does not automatically control the subtraction in R_s;the audited rare-target positivity/precision condition or alternate estimator is required. No mean/time-distribution/physical sampler is earned from rarity alone.
